units.rawText: Dear Editor:<|> This is Nora, and it is with a heavy heart that I must relay this unfortunate news to you. As a writer, it was never my intention to be caught up in an intense gun battle for the sake of seizing the Professor or to be surrounded, shot, and be renamed to No-"I've got to delay it even though I don't want to delay it"-ra. While my submission is now late, my mind remains unchanged. I remain a diligent, committed writer who will follow through with her manuscripts in order to fulfill her duties to her reading audience. No matter what I produce, there can be only one outcome...
